column1: # High alerts of the signed-in active scan (scripts/ci/zap-signed-in.sh) that
# were reviewed and shown to be false positives. Every other High alert fails
# the scan. An entry covers one rule, one method, one exact path and one
# parameter, and names the test that proves it; the reason goes on the lines
# above it (CiWorkflowsTest). Remove an entry when its reason no longer holds.
# Format: rule id <TAB> method <TAB> path <TAB> parameter <TAB> test
# SQL Injection (40018), 2026-11-16, operations run 43761057926: ZAP sent
# name="ZAP' AND '1'='1' --" then "... '1'='2' --" with the same teacher
# code; the second page differed because two teachers never share a code
# ("Another teacher already has this code"), not because of the condition.
# The name is saved through Eloquent with bound parameters; the test stores
# SQL payloads verbatim on create and rename and replays ZAP's pair.
